- Success metric: 40% reduction in MTTR for top-incident class within pilot.

We had the technical deep dive on the calendar for today (eng block reserved at 10:00 PT) but the session didn't happen — totally understand that things slip. Team availability for follow-up engineering time this week is narrow. To avoid losing the slot we can offer three tightly-held 25-min technical windows (we'll bring an engineer + solution architect):

1) Mon 30 Nov — 09:30–09:55 PT
2) Mon 30 Nov — 10:00–10:25 PT
3) Tue 01 Dec — 09:00–09:25 PT

If you can confirm one of those in the next 6 hours we'll lock it. Otherwise we need to release the engineering block and move to the next available window next week.

- You confirm the slot and attendees (SRE + Eng manager preferred)
- We send calendar invite + pre-read (short runbook + specific data examples to bring)

If the three options above don't work, tell me two times that do and I'll escalate to Marissa to carve out longer availability.

Thanks — appreciate the quick reply.

— Diego
